en.name: Plank
setup: Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach as if about to be poked.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor.
Pushing the hips high into a pike.

en.name: Crunch
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your fingertips beside your head or cross your arms on your chest.
execution: Curl your shoulders off the floor by bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Pulling on the head with the hands.
Lifting the whole back off the floor with momentum.

en.name: Hanging Leg Raise
setup: Hang from a bar with straight arms and your legs together.
Pull your shoulders down slightly to stop swinging.
execution: Raise your straight legs until they are at least level with your hips, curling the pelvis up at the top.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the body to throw the legs up.
Lifting only with the hip flexors and never curling the pelvis.

en.name: Sit-Up
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, anchored if needed.
Cross your arms on your chest.
execution: Curl up through your spine until your chest is near your thighs.
Roll back down slowly one segment at a time.
mistakes: Dropping back to the floor quickly.

en.name: Russian Twist
setup: Sit with knees bent and lean back until your torso is about 45 degrees.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest and lift your feet if you can.
execution: Rotate your shoulders to one side, then to the other.
Keep the chest up throughout.
mistakes: Moving only the arms instead of the torso.

en.name: Cable Crunch
setup: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing it.
Hold the rope beside your head.
execution: Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly until your back is long.
mistakes: Sitting back and pulling with the hips.

en.name: Mountain Climber
setup: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
execution: Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips level and shoulders over your hands.
mistakes: Bouncing the hips up and down.
Letting the shoulders drift behind the hands.

en.name: Side Plank
setup: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
execution: Hold the line while breathing steadily.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Rolling the chest toward the floor.

en.name: Bicycle Crunch
setup: Lie on your back with your hands lightly beside your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees above your hips.
execution: Turn one shoulder toward the opposite knee as that leg pulls in and the other extends.
Switch sides in a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Pulling the head with the hands.
Moving the elbows instead of rotating the torso.

en.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
setup: Kneel on a mat holding the wheel under your shoulders.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your core.
execution: Roll the wheel forward as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull the wheel back to the start using your abs.
mistakes: Pushing the hips back first on the return.
en.safety: Stop the roll before your lower back starts to arch.

en.name: Lying Leg Raise
setup: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
execution: Raise your legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly as far as you can while the lower back stays down.
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.

en.name: Dead Bug
setup: Lie on your back with your arms pointing at the ceiling.
Lift your knees above your hips with shins parallel to the floor.
execution: Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor at the same time.
Return and switch sides.

en.name: Bird Dog
setup: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat.
execution: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold briefly, return and switch.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to lift the leg higher.

en.name: Reverse Crunch
setup: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift your knees above your hips, bent at 90 degrees.
execution: Curl your hips off the floor by bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly.
mistakes: Only moving the legs without lifting the hips.

en.name: Flutter Kick
setup: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your heels a few centimetres off the floor.
execution: Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating movements.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

en.name: V-Up
setup: Lie flat with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Brace your stomach.
execution: Lift your arms and legs together, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Lower back down with control.

en.name: Cable Woodchop
setup: Set a pulley high and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands above your near shoulder.
execution: Pull the handle down and across your body to the opposite hip, turning your torso.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Twisting through the lower back instead of turning the hips and chest.

en.name: Cable Pallof Press
setup: Set a pulley at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle against your chest and step away until the cable is taut.
execution: Press the handle straight out in front of you without letting your body turn.
Hold for a breath, then bring it back.
mistakes: Letting the torso rotate toward the stack.
Standing too close for any tension.

en.name: Hanging Knee Raise
setup: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down slightly.
execution: Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis up.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Raising the knees only to hip height without curling.

en.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
setup: Support yourself on your forearms in a captain's chair or between dip bars.
Press your back against the pad.
execution: Raise your knees toward your chest.
Lower them slowly.

en.name: Toes-to-Bar
setup: Hang from a bar with straight arms, hands about shoulder width.
Brace your core.
execution: Pull down on the bar slightly and raise your feet until they touch the bar.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Decline Crunch
setup: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads.
Cross your arms on your chest.
execution: Curl your shoulders up until your upper back leaves the bench.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Hollow Body Hold
setup: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
execution: Lift your arms, shoulders and legs off the floor into a shallow banana shape.
Hold while breathing steadily.

en.name: Decline Sit-Up
setup: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench.
Hold a plate against your chest for extra load if needed.
execution: Curl up until your torso is upright.
Lower slowly to the bench.

en.name: Machine Crunch
setup: Adjust the seat and hold the handles or pads.
Sit tall.
execution: Crunch forward by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly.

en.name: High Plank
setup: Place your hands under your shoulders and straighten your arms.
Step back so your body is straight.
execution: Hold the position while bracing your stomach and squeezing your glutes.
Breathe steadily.

en.name: Stability Ball Crunch
setup: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until the ball supports your lower back.
Let your upper back drape over the ball.
execution: Curl your ribs toward your hips.
Lower back over the ball slowly.
mistakes: Rolling the ball instead of crunching.

en.name: L-Sit
setup: Grip the dip bars or parallettes with straight arms.
Press down so your shoulders are away from your ears.
execution: Lift your legs straight in front of you until they are level with your hips.
Hold for the set time.

en.name: Dragon Flag
setup: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your legs and hips so your weight rests on your upper back.
execution: Lower your straight body slowly toward the bench, hinging only at the shoulders.
Raise it back up without bending at the hips.
en.safety: Learn negatives first; this places heavy load on the lower back if your form breaks.

en.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand on your hip.
execution: Bend sideways toward the dumbbell.
Return to upright using the opposite side of your waist.
mistakes: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, which cancels the load.

en.name: Heel Touch
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, a little wider than hips.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
execution: Reach one hand toward the same-side heel by bending sideways.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the head drop back down.

en.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
setup: Start in a high plank with feet a little wider than hips.
Brace your core.
execution: Lift one hand and touch the opposite shoulder.
Switch hands without letting the hips sway.
mistakes: Rocking the hips side to side.

en.name: Landmine Rotation
setup: Stand facing a landmine bar and hold its end with both hands at arm's length above your head.
Set your feet wider than your hips.
execution: Lower the bar in an arc to one hip, turning your torso and pivoting your feet.
Bring it back over the top and to the other side.
mistakes: Twisting only from the lower back.

en.name: Lying Windshield Wiper
setup: Lie on your back with arms out wide and legs raised straight up.
Press your shoulders into the floor.
execution: Lower your legs to one side while keeping both shoulders down.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.

en.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
setup: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with legs stacked.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
execution: Lower your hip toward the floor without touching it.
Lift it back up above the line.

en.name: Weighted Plank
setup: Set up in a forearm plank.
Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, below the neck.
execution: Hold a straight body for the set time.
Have the plate removed before you drop.
mistakes: Placing the plate on the lower back.
cues: Brace like a plank, just heavier

en.name: Kneeling Side Plank
setup: Lie on your side on your forearm with knees bent behind you.
Line up your head, hips and knees.
execution: Lift your hips and hold the line.
Switch sides.

en.name: Band Pallof Press
setup: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold it at your chest and step away until it is taut.
execution: Press your hands straight out and hold for a breath.
Bring them back without turning.

en.name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the wheel on the floor in front of your feet.
Bend at the hips to grip it.
execution: Roll forward until your body is nearly parallel to the floor.
Pull back to the start without bending the hips first.
mistakes: Rolling further than you can return from.
en.safety: Master full kneeling rollouts first; this variation loads the lower back heavily.

en.name: Rotary Torso Machine
setup: Sit in the machine and lock your legs in place.
Hold the handles with your chest against the pad.
execution: Rotate your torso to one side against the resistance.
Return slowly and finish the set before switching sides.
mistakes: Using a range that hurts the lower back.

en.name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
setup: Hang from a bar and raise your straight legs until your feet are near the bar.
Hold the top position.
execution: Rotate your legs to one side, then to the other, like windshield wipers.
Keep the upper body steady.

en.name: Plate Russian Twist
setup: Sit with knees bent and hold a plate at your chest.
Lean back to about 45 degrees.
execution: Rotate the plate to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest up.

en.name: Band Woodchop
setup: Anchor a band high and stand side-on to it.
Hold it with both hands above your near shoulder.
execution: Pull down and across to the opposite hip, turning your chest.
Return slowly.

en.name: Low-to-High Cable Woodchop
setup: Set a pulley low and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands by your near hip.
execution: Pull the handle up and across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Return slowly.

en.name: Stability Ball Rollout
setup: Kneel behind a stability ball with your forearms on top of it.
Brace your core with your body straight from knees to head.
execution: Roll the ball forward on your forearms until your body is extended.
Pull back to the start.

en.name: Ab Wheel Wall Rollout
setup: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel between you and the wall.
Set the distance so the wheel stops at a range you can control.
execution: Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull back to the start.

en.name: Ab Wheel Diagonal Rollout
setup: Kneel holding the ab wheel under your shoulders.
Brace with your pelvis tucked.
execution: Roll the wheel forward and diagonally to one side.
Pull back and repeat to the other side.

en.name: Stir the Pot
setup: Place your forearms on a stability ball and step back into a plank.
Set your feet slightly wider than hips.
execution: Move your forearms in small circles as if stirring a pot.
Change direction halfway through.

en.name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
setup: Place your shins on a stability ball and your hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Brace so your body is straight.
execution: Pull your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward.
Roll it back out to the start.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders drift behind the hands.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Knee Tuck
setup: Place your feet in the foot cradles facing the floor.
Walk out into a push-up position.
execution: Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend back to a plank.

en.name: Stability Ball Pike
setup: Place your shins on a stability ball in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
execution: Lift your hips high, rolling the ball toward your hands with straight legs.
Lower back to a plank.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Pike
setup: Place your feet in the foot cradles facing the floor.
Walk out into a push-up position.
execution: Lift your hips toward the ceiling, keeping legs straight.
Lower back to a plank.
